title: Words that end in a consonant

sections.title: Adding the ending
sections.content: A noun that ends in a consonant takes the ending as it is: *bolt* becomes *boltban*, *park* becomes *parkban*. Nothing is lengthened and nothing is added. A long vowel inside the word stays as it is: *könyvtár* becomes *könyvtárban* and *osztály* becomes *osztályban*. Both have a back vowel, so both take *-ban*.

items.english: The book is in the library.

sections.content: Only a final *-a* or *-e* changes. Compare *szoba* → *szobában* with *bolt* → *boltban*: the first needs a long *á*, the second just takes the ending. Words that end in a consonant, like *park*, never change.
